articles.summary: Insights brings together the metrics, logs, and traces from your agents, applications, and infrastructure with nothing to instrument. Dashboards, alerts, and a query builder let you trace an issue to its root cause without switching tools.
articles.title: Introducing DigitalOcean Insights: Built-in Observability for Your Agents, Applications, and Infrastructure

articles.summary: Agent Droplets are available today for DigitalOcean Managed Agents in public preview. If you already run agents on Claude Code, Codex CLI, or OpenCode, point them at DigitalOcean and they can run on an Agent Droplet with minimal setup. New DigitalOcean users get a $5 credit to launch their first agent session.
articles.title: Introducing Agent Droplets: everything an agent needs, one price, one bill

articles.summary: Understand how Action Gateway in DigitalOcean Managed Agents validates tool calls, applies approval policies, and keeps credentials away from the model.
articles.title: Inside Action Gateway in Managed Agents

articles.summary: DigitalOcean Agent Data Services, now in private preview, gives agents one managed place to read the context they need and write back what happened. Data Flows process, enrich, and index new data as it arrives, so multimodal content, structured records, and agent sessions land in one governed catalog, searchable by meaning in a single call.
articles.title: Introducing DigitalOcean Agent Data Services: The Data Foundation for Agents

articles.summary: Find out where your agents and models fail in production, then test the fix before it ships. Signals watches traffic on Managed Agents and Serverless Inference and flags the sessions that went wrong, with nothing extra to instrument. Evaluations and Simulations test your change on realistic multi-turn scenarios built from those sessions or from your agent’s configuration.
articles.title: Introducing DigitalOcean Signals and Simulations: see how your agents and models really behave in production, then test the fix before it ships

articles.summary: Introducing Resource Limits for Organizations and configurable session durations for Accounts.
articles.title: Account Control, Every Layer: From Your Organization to Every Session

articles.summary: DigitalOcean MicroVMs are now in public preview: isolated VMs that pause when idle, resume in milliseconds, and bill compute only while running.
articles.title: DigitalOcean MicroVMs: Fast, isolated compute for your AI agent infrastructure

articles.summary: Build your own agent platform on DigitalOcean MicroVMs: isolated Firecracker VMs that pause when idle and resume with state intact. Now in private preview.
articles.title: DigitalOcean MicroVMs: the Compute foundation for building your AI agent infrastructure (private preview)

articles.summary: Learn how DigitalOcean’s MicroVM architecture uses Firecracker, policy-enforcing proxies, and lazy memory restore to resume agent sessions in milliseconds.
articles.title: Building a computer that can pause and resume in milliseconds: Inside the MicroVM architecture behind Managed Agents

articles.summary: Today, we’re enhancing the DigitalOcean Inference Router so it makes that call for you. No presets to select, no custom routers to build. Send your prompt, set the model to inference-router, and choose a preference if you want one. The router sends each request to the model that performs best for that job, validated by public benchmarks.
articles.title: DigitalOcean Inference Router Enhancements: Performance Tuned Routing, No Rules to Write
